description: Review a stack described as a list of services, such as s3, rds, lambda. Optionally add a sentence about the workload. Same output rules as review_iac: the top 3 findings without a valid API key, everything with one. Nothing but the key, rule ids, and a count of services leaves this machine.

intent.description: One or two sentences about the workload, for example whether it is public-facing.

tokens.description: Service ids or names. Examples: s3, rds, Amazon EC2, Key Vault.

name: review_stack
title: Review a list of services
